stats.label: Sensex close on Friday — back above 80,000 for the first time in more than nine months
Roughly the foreign portfolio buying in Indian stocks during the run — Rs 49,500 crore

diaspora_bullets: The week's 8.8% Sensex gain was the market's best since February 2021
The rally added about Rs 29.57 lakh crore to investor wealth
news_summary: The Sensex rose 10.6% across seven straight winning sessions into Diwali, its strongest seven-session pre-Diwali run in 35 years, as foreign portfolio investors bought about Rs 49,500 crore of Indian stocks.
payoff: The rally's durability now depends on FPI follow-through rather than on any single earnings print.
